name: FairTix Lottery Winner Notification System

The system sends professionally branded emails with purchase links and transparent pricing, then tracks delivery status back to the source spreadsheet. This reveals FairTix operates as an anti-scalping ticketing platform that uses lottery selection instead of traditional first-come-first-served sales, positioning transparency and fairness as key differentiators against competitors like Ticketmaster.
